intro.name: Muhammad Naufal Musyaddad
intro.description: I don't just write code to make things work. I engineer secure, scalable web and mobile applications that deliver real value. With hands-on internship experience in internal systems and a strong adaptability to modern tech stacks, I build solutions that are as safe as they are seamless.

web.title: Web Development
web.des: Building robust frontend and backend functionality across diverse technology stacks, prioritizing reliable system performance, clean logic, and fully responsive layouts that adapt seamlessly from desktop to mobile.

mobile.title: Mobile App Development
mobile.des: Leveraging Flutter Framework to accelerate development process without compromising quality, delivering native-like performance and smooth UI consistency across various OS versions.

testing.title: Functional & Non-functional Tests
testing.des: Ensuring system reliability by moving beyond standard functional checks to thoroughly evaluate critical backend metrics, including performance efficiency and security standards

clean.title: Clean Code
clean.des: Writing maintainable, readable code and implementing clean architecture principles when needed, ensuring long-term scalability and effortless handoffs for future developers.

doc.title: Technical Documentation
doc.des: Crafting clear, structured documentation for both solo and team projects, serving as a reliable reference for future maintenance and long-term project continuity.

research.title: Tool Research & Customization
research.des: Exploring, evaluating, and custom-modifying open-source tools to streamline development pipelines, boost engineering efficiency, and optimize the overall build process.

desc.bookingPlatform: Distributed microservices booking system consisting of Core, Booking, and Payment services. Built with Go, RabbitMQ, postgreSQL, Redis, and Docker. Each services structure follows Clean Architecture pattern for maintainability.
desc.pawtastic: Online E-commerce app for pet supplies with interesting UI Design. Built with Flutter framework and Supabase (postgres) as backend for authentication and database. Integrated third-party services including RajaOngkir for logistics and Gemini API for AI-powered features.
desc.internalPlatform: An internal company website with a comprehensive sysadmin menu for user and role-permission system. Menus or modules can also be manually configured by the administrator.
desc.laravelPulse: Extended Laravel Pulse library into a scalable, centralized dashboard capable of tracking performance across multiple Laravel applications, which was originally designed for single-app monitoring.
desc.shrinkBg: Web-based, client-side image processing tool built with TypeScript allows to remove image backgrounds automatically and refine masks using a built-in canvas editor with undo/redo support. Background colors can be customized and compressed in offline mode.
desc.boomBalloon: Spawn 3D balloon objects using smartphone camera, and shoot the balloon to get the highest score. Challenge yourself in the timed mode against the clock, or enjoy a relaxed experience in the untimed free-play mode.
